rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Hot Pewter
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1978).
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1979 as 'Hot Pewter'.
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Mild fragrance. 41 petals. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to Mildew. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Alec's Red® (hybrid tea, Cocker, 1970) ×
